colors.instructions: Use high-contrast monochrome as base. Color is used ONLY for function. Use tint of gray, never pure black/gray.

layouts.general: High Density Grid optimized for web app dashboards. Minimalist and professional.
layouts.dashboard: Flex layout with w-64 fixed sidebar, h-screen sticky. Main content takes remaining width. Use p-6 or p-8 for main containers to ensure generous spacing.
layouts.bento_grid: For the 'Tambah Arsip' form, utilize a bento-style grid structure (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6) to break up inputs instead of a massive single column.
layouts.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 'Grid Borders' style with border-collapse and subtle borders.

components.sidebar: Flat surface, no shadow, border-r border-neutral-200. Active states get a subtle bg-neutral-100 and font-medium.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Flat solid surfaces with 1px subtle borders. Max 4px border-radius (rounded-sm). Left-align all textual data.
components.buttons: Rounded-sm corners. Dark/Black for primary actions (Tambah Arsip). Minimal padding, crisp borders.
components.forms: Use Shadcn components exclusively for interactive logic. Labels must be uppercase and tracked out (tracking-[0.1em]). Inputs should have sharp borders (border-neutral-300 focus:border-neutral-900 focus:ring-1).
components.toast: Use Sonner for success/error notifications ('Arsip berhasil ditambahkan').
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog with solid white background, 1px border, and a subtle backdrop-blur for overlay.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Avoid soft UI blobs. When shadows are needed (dropdowns, dialogs), use sharp, deliberate ambient shadows: shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)].
visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for a dense, professional tech look.

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions on hover for table rows (bg-neutral-50) and buttons (subtle bg shifts).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform). NO transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure min 4.5:1 ratio. Text colors MUST be explicitly set on hover/focus states.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='search-archive-input').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React (JS, not TSX) + Tailwind + Shadcn application.
All UI Text MUST be in Indonesian as requested.
Authentication (Login Page): Implement JWT-style Login UI. Clean split layout or centered minimalist card. Hardcode admin/admin check for prototype if no backend provided.
Layout Shell: Build a Sidebar containing menus: Dashboard, Tambah Arsip, Cari Arsip, Pengaturan.
Menu 1 - Tambah Arsip: Form for nomor arsip, nama arsip, jenis arsip, lokasi arsip, and upload arsip (PDF). Use Shadcn forms.
Menu 2 - Cari Arsip: Search input by nomor/nama. Table displaying results. Action column with 'Ubah' (Edit) button opening a pre-filled form (via Modal or dedicated page).
Menu 3 - Hapus Arsip: Similar to Cari Arsip, but action column has 'Hapus' (Delete) button that triggers a Shadcn Alert Dialog.
Menu 4 - Pengaturan: Settings page using Shadcn Tabs for 'Input User', 'Jenis Arsip', and 'Lokasi Arsip'.
Implement Role checking visually if applicable (e.g., Hapus Arsip only visible/enabled for admin).
Do NOT use generic Vercel/Stripe gradient cards. Keep surfaces solid, flat, and brutalist-adjacent.
Provide clear Empty States for the tables if no archives are found.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use transparent backgrounds for headers, dropdowns, or modals where content can scroll underneath.
Avoid center aligning layouts for dense information; always use left alignment for forms and data.
Create new components in src/components/ui/ following existing Shadcn aesthetic.
Never use generic AI emojis in the UI. Rely on Phosphor icons.
Ensure hover states explicitly declare text colors (e.g., hover:bg-neutral-900 hover:text-white).
Do not apply `transition: all` in CSS.
The application code will be in standard JS (.js/.jsx), not TypeScript.
